name: SectionTabs
description: A component for organizing content into distinct sections accessible via tab navigation. Can operate in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
usage: Use for organizing content into distinct sections accessible via tab navigation
Supports both controlled (state managed by parent via activeTabId/onTabChange) and uncontrolled (internal state managed, uses initialSectionId and children render prop) modes
In uncontrolled mode with children render prop, component manages internal state and wraps content in Section component
In controlled mode, component only renders tab buttons; parent is responsible for rendering content and any desired Section wrapper
contentPadding prop has no effect in controlled mode
Each tab can include optional icon before the title and optional badge after the title
Allows disabling specific tabs via disabled property on section data
Designed to be placed within a Section or Card component (Level 2 or 3 in hierarchy)
design: Supports both controlled (state managed by parent via activeTabId/onTabChange) and uncontrolled (internal state managed, uses initialSectionId and children render prop) modes
Parent determines content rendering location (via children prop if uncontrolled, or externally if controlled)
In uncontrolled mode, the content rendered by the children prop is automatically wrapped in a Section component. The contentPadding and contentClassName props customize this internal Section
In controlled mode, the component only renders the tab buttons; the parent is responsible for rendering the content and any desired Section wrapper
Uses design system tokens for styling (--color-primary, --color-text-muted, --color-border-subtle)
Provides className props for customizing different parts of the component (container, tabs, content section, individual buttons)
Designed to be placed within a Section or Card component (Level 2 or 3 in hierarchy)
accessibility: Applies appropriate ARIA attributes (future enhancement, currently basic)
Disabled tabs use disabled attribute and have reduced opacity with cursor-not-allowed
Buttons have focus-visible ring styling for keyboard navigation

props.name: sections
props.description: An array of objects defining the tabs. Each object has shape: { id: string; title: string; disabled?: boolean; icon?: ReactNode; badge?: ReactNode }

props.name: children
props.description: Optional render prop function. If provided, component acts uncontrolled and renders content wrapped in Section component

props.name: activeTabId
props.description: Optional. If provided, component acts controlled. Active tab ID is managed externally

props.name: onTabChange
props.description: Optional callback triggered on tab click. Required if controlled

props.name: initialSectionId
props.description: Optional. Sets the initial active tab for uncontrolled mode

props.name: className
props.description: Custom CSS classes for individual tab buttons

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Custom CSS classes for the outer container div

props.name: tabsClassName
props.description: Custom CSS classes for the div containing the tab buttons

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Custom CSS classes for the internal Section component (uncontrolled mode only)

props.name: contentPadding
props.description: Padding prop passed to the internal Section component (uncontrolled mode only)
